description: Source code for the 'bbf.config' daemon, managing configuration via ubus, handling services, triggers, and events in an embedded Linux environment.

methods.name: receive_notify_event
methods.description: Handles 'bbf.config.notify' events, triggers configuration change events unless internal commit flag is set.

methods.name: send_bbf_config_change_event
methods.description: Sends 'bbf.config.change' event via ubus to notify other components of configuration updates.

methods.name: send_reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message over ubus with specified message and description.

methods.name: complete_deferred_request
methods.description: Completes an asynchronous ubus request, sends 'ok' status, triggers config change event, and resets internal commit flag.

methods.name: end_request_callback
methods.description: Callback to finalize deferred request after timeout.

methods.name: complete_request_callback
methods.description: Checks if services are reloaded, then completes request or retries after delay.

methods.name: get_blob_attr_with_idx
methods.description: Retrieves blob attribute matching protocol index.

methods.name: check_if_critical_service
methods.description: Determines if a service is marked as critical for a given protocol.

methods.name: get_monitor_status
methods.description: Checks if any critical services are present to enable monitoring.

methods.name: bbf_config_commit_handler
methods.description: Handles 'commit' ubus method, applies configuration changes, manages async requests, and triggers events.

methods.name: bbf_config_revert_handler
methods.description: Handles 'revert' ubus method, reverts configuration changes, and triggers events.

methods.name: update_critical_services
methods.description: Updates critical services list in the configuration.

methods.name: bbf_config_changes_handler
methods.description: Handles 'changes' ubus method, applies configuration diffs, and updates critical services.

methods.name: load_critical_services
methods.description: Loads critical services list from JSON file into blob buffer.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes ubus context, registers object and event handler, loads critical services, and runs event loop.
